In this episode, Chris Rodriguez • Travelwithchris and I spoke with Jonathan from the Travel Escapes channel sharing his experience living in the Philippines, highlighting the warm hospitality of the locals, the ease of using English, and a more peaceful lifestyle compared to the United States. We covered the country's general safety, candid thoughts on local food, and practical advice for aspiring content creators looking to start their own journey
